source_name: WITS (World Bank) / UN Comtrade — India exports by partner, calendar year 2024
notes: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE ON COMPLETENESS — figures are primary-tier (WITS/UN Comtrade) but the USD 11.67M total under legacy code 0307.49 looks LOW relative to India's known cephalopod trade, which suggests much of the volume is reported under other 0307 subheadings (0307.42/0307.43/0307.99 splits differ across HS revisions and reporting years). Treat the country RANKING (USA ~47%, then Spain, Italy, France) as directionally sound, but do NOT present the total as India's complete squid/cuttlefish export value. Note the strongly European/Mediterranean skew — Spain, Italy, France, Belgium and Greece all appear, which supports Spanish/Italian-language content for this line specifically.
